content:
The next Indian unicorn might not be an app.
It might be an AI agent.

And The Ken ’s Case Competition 2026 is asking students to figure out what that future could look like.

With Zerodha as the title partner, teams will pick real consumer problems, uncover overlooked insights, and design or build agents to solve them.

● The interesting part?

gnani.ai , Pine Labs and Delhivery are opening parts of their infrastructure for teams to test their ideas.

₹20 lakh in prizes.
Teams of 1–3.
Any college. Any discipline.
No coding required.

The best solutions will also feed into The Ken’s October report on how agentic AI could reshape India.

● If you’re a college student, this isn’t just a case competition. It’s a chance to build for what’s next.
